description: Fourth converted statistics pass. Adds Hypertext d20-compatible named stat blocks for three High Lords and four territorial Dragon Lords.

entries.title: Ixaryth the Storm-Winged
entries.summary: A tempestuous blue High Lord rules coastal wildlands and oceanic floating islands for the Draconic Emperor, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Ixaryth is one of the Emperor's direct lieutenants, combining elemental authority with responsibility for lesser Dragon Lords across maritime territory.
His rule depends on command of storms, long-range aerial superiority, and the ability to turn coastal weather into a weapon against fleets and rebellious islands.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as an epic blue-dragon sovereign whose battlefield identity is storm command, fleet disruption, and regional weather control rather than a simple enlarged breath weapon.

statBlocks.title: Ixaryth the Storm-Winged
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +39 melee (4d8+15 plus 2d6 electricity), 2 claws +37 melee (4d6+7), 2 wings +37 melee (2d8+7), and tail slap +37 melee (4d6+22)
specialAttacks: Storm-Lance Breath (Su): 160-ft. line, 18d8 electricity damage, Reflex DC 33 half, every 1d4 rounds. Creatures failing the save are also deafened for 1d4 rounds.

Tempest Dominion (Su): As a standard action, Ixaryth creates or intensifies a storm in a 1-mile radius for 10 minutes per use. Within it, ranged attacks take a -8 penalty, unprotected flames are extinguished, and flying creatures other than Ixaryth must succeed on DC 30 Fly or Reflex checks each round or lose 20 ft. of altitude.

Fleetbreaker Arc (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, Ixaryth may chain lightning through up to eight targets within 120 ft.; the first takes 12d6 electricity damage and each later target takes 2d6 less, Reflex DC 31 half.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch, tail sweep
specialQualities: Immunity to electricity, paralysis, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Coastal wildlands, storm seas, oceanic floating islands
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, imperial court, or storm retinue (Ixaryth plus 2-6 adult blue dragons and 20-100 draconic troops)
statBlocks.treasure: Triple standard plus imperial regalia and regional tribute
tactics: Begins by establishing Tempest Dominion before enemies can organize ranged fire.
Targets ships, flying formations, and spellcasters with Fleetbreaker Arc.
Uses altitude and weather to avoid static melee unless defending a seat of power.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: blue High Lord and coastal-maritime regional sovereign.
Storm abilities are intentionally fleet-scale to distinguish High Lord status from ordinary blue dragons.

entries.title: Krorithyx the Iron-Hide
entries.summary: An ancient black High Lord oversees corrupted marshes and lowlands beneath the Emperor's hierarchy, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Krorithyx serves as a direct draconic vassal and regional authority over dangerous wetland territories, lesser rulers, and the tribute they owe upward.
His legendary hide and mastery of corrosive terrain make direct assault extraordinarily costly.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as an epic black-dragon sovereign centered on attrition, acid saturation, terrain corruption, and near-impenetrable armor.

statBlocks.title: Krorithyx the Iron-Hide
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +42 melee (4d8+16 plus 2d6 acid), 2 claws +40 melee (4d6+8), 2 wings +40 melee (2d8+8), and tail slap +40 melee (4d6+24)
specialAttacks: Corrosive Deluge Breath (Su): 100-ft. cone, 20d6 acid damage, Reflex DC 35 half, every 1d4 rounds. Nonmagical metal and wood in the area take half damage ignoring hardness.

Bog of Dissolution (Su): As a standard action, Krorithyx corrupts a 60-ft.-radius area for 10 rounds. Ground becomes sucking acidic mire; movement costs quadruple, and creatures entering or starting their turn there take 4d6 acid damage.
Iron-Hide Reprisal (Ex): A creature striking Krorithyx with a non-reach natural weapon or unarmed attack takes 2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 acid damage from jagged, caustic scales.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch, tail sweep
specialQualities: Immunity to acid, paralysis, and sleep
Fast healing 5 while touching swamp water or mud
statBlocks.environment: Corrupted marshes, acidic lowlands, drowned ruins
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, tribute court, or mire host (Krorithyx plus 2-5 black dragons and 30-200 swamp vassals)
statBlocks.treasure: Triple standard plus marsh tribute vaults
tactics: Turns the battlefield into Bog of Dissolution before committing to melee.
Uses his extreme armor and reprisal scales to punish swarms and natural attackers.
Retreats into deep corrosive water to exploit fast healing if heavily damaged.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: ancient black High Lord of corrupted marshes and lowlands.
Iron-Hide is represented by unusually high natural armor, epic damage reduction, and reactive scale damage.

entries.title: Sylvekar the Verdant Keeper
entries.summary: A jealous green High Lord guards immense jungles and the treasures hidden within them, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Sylvekar represents a verdant draconic lineage among the Emperor's highest vassals and maintains order over jungle domains through territorial power and guarded wealth.
He prefers layered deception, living defenses, and poison over open warfare.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as an epic green-dragon sovereign centered on domination, poisonous jungle control, and deceptive territorial warfare.

statBlocks.title: Sylvekar the Verdant Keeper
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +37 melee (4d8+14 plus poison), 2 claws +35 melee (4d6+7), 2 wings +35 melee (2d8+7), and tail slap +35 melee (4d6+21)
specialAttacks: Viridian Miasma Breath (Su): 100-ft. cone, 18d6 acid damage, Reflex DC 32 half, every 1d4 rounds. Creatures failing also take 1d6 Constitution damage unless they succeed on a DC 30 Fortitude save.
Keeper's Command (Su): Three times per day, Sylvekar may dominate monster as a spell-like ability, caster level 18th, Will DC 27. Jungle creatures and plants take a -4 penalty on the save.

Living Labyrinth (Su): Once per day, Sylvekar animates vegetation in a 300-ft. radius for 20 minutes. The area functions as entangle and hallucinatory terrain simultaneously, and Sylvekar may move through it without impediment.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch, tail sweep
specialQualities: Immunity to acid, paralysis, poison, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Immense jungles, poisonous canopy realms, hidden treasure valleys
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, verdant court, or jungle dominion (Sylvekar plus 2-6 green dragons and 50-300 enthralled creatures)
statBlocks.treasure: Triple standard plus unique jungle relics
tactics: Uses Living Labyrinth to divide intruders before revealing himself.
Attempts domination against enemy leaders, guides, and local beasts.
Fights from concealment and retreats deeper into prepared jungle terrain rather than trading attacks openly.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: jealous green High Lord guarding immense jungles and hidden treasures.
Verdant Keeper identity is expressed through domination, poison, and battlefield-scale animated vegetation.

entries.title: Kaldryxis the Infernal Sovereign
entries.summary: A red Dragon Lord rules volcanic badlands cut by lava rivers and ash storms, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Kaldryxis governs a domain whose destructive terrain reflects red-dragon fire and severity.
Settlements survive through tribute, preparation, and avoidance of both ruler and landscape.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as a high-level red-dragon domain boss focused on volcanic control, terror, and direct destructive power.

statBlocks.title: Kaldryxis the Infernal Sovereign
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +36 melee (3d8+14 plus 2d6 fire), 2 claws +34 melee (2d8+7), 2 wings +34 melee (2d6+7), and tail slap +34 melee (2d8+21)
specialAttacks: Inferno Breath (Su): 80-ft. cone, 16d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 30 half, every 1d4 rounds.

Lava-River Command (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, Kaldryxis opens a 60-ft.-long, 10-ft.-wide fissure of lava on stone or earth within 120 ft. Creatures in the area take 8d6 fire damage, Reflex DC 28 half; the fissure remains hazardous for 5 rounds.
Ash-Tyrant Roar (Su): 60-ft. cone, Fortitude DC 27 or blinded and sickened for 1d4 rounds.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch, tail sweep
specialQualities: Immunity to fire, paralysis, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Volcanic badlands, lava rivers, ash-storm territories
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, volcanic court, or war flight (Kaldryxis plus 1-4 red dragons and 20-100 vassals)
tactics: Uses lava fissures to cut escape routes and isolate targets.
Prefers direct terror and repeated fire attacks over subtlety.
Retreats into volcanic vents where cold-based pursuit is difficult.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: red Dragon Lord of volcanic badlands, lava rivers, and ash storms.

entries.title: Vaelyth the Frostfang
entries.summary: A white Dragon Lord dominates frozen lakes, glacial peaks, and icy caverns, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Vaelyth's tundra domain is shaped by cold, isolation, and difficult movement.
Mortal subjects face the demands of both a territorial dragon and a punishing frozen environment.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as a mobile white-dragon ambusher with glacial terrain control and predatory pursuit abilities.

statBlocks.title: Vaelyth the Frostfang
speed: Burrow 40 ft. through ice and snow
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +31 melee (3d8+12 plus 2d6 cold), 2 claws +29 melee (2d8+6), 2 wings +29 melee (2d6+6), and tail slap +29 melee (2d8+18)
specialAttacks: Frostfang Breath (Su): 70-ft. cone, 14d8 cold damage, Reflex DC 27 half, every 1d4 rounds.

Glacial Rupture (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, Vaelyth shatters ice in a 40-ft. radius within 100 ft. Creatures take 6d6 piercing and cold damage and must succeed on a DC 25 Reflex save or fall prone and become entangled in broken ice.
Whiteout Ambush (Ex): In snow, fog, or ice storm conditions, Vaelyth gains total concealment beyond 30 ft. and deals +4d6 damage on the first successful attack after emerging from concealment.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch
specialQualities: Immunity to cold, paralysis, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Frozen lakes, glacial peaks, ice caverns
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, hunting pair, or frost court (Vaelyth plus 1-3 white dragons and tundra vassals)
tactics: Begins hidden in snow or ice, striking isolated targets.
Uses Glacial Rupture to immobilize groups before closing.
Pursues weakened enemies relentlessly across frozen terrain.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: white Dragon Lord of tundra, glaciers, frozen lakes, and icy caverns.

entries.title: Zephyros the Stormcaller
entries.summary: A blue Dragon Lord rules a desert of perpetual sandstorms and ancient ruins, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Zephyros controls a domain where visibility, navigation, and access to buried history are shaped by endless storms.
Tribute and survival both depend on reliable routes through the wastes.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as a blue-dragon battlefield controller specializing in sandstorms, buried ruins, and lightning ambushes.

statBlocks.title: Zephyros the Stormcaller
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +32 melee (3d8+12 plus 2d6 electricity), 2 claws +30 melee (2d8+6), 2 wings +30 melee (2d6+6), and tail slap +30 melee (2d8+18)
specialAttacks: Stormcaller Breath (Su): 120-ft. line, 15d8 electricity damage, Reflex DC 28 half, every 1d4 rounds.

Perpetual Sandstorm (Su): Three times per day, Zephyros creates a 300-ft.-radius sandstorm lasting 10 minutes. Visibility drops to 5 ft., creatures take 1d3 nonlethal damage per round, and exposed movement is reduced by half.

Buried Ruin Collapse (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds while over stone, sand, or ruins, Zephyros collapses a 30-ft.-radius area within 150 ft.; 8d6 bludgeoning damage, Reflex DC 26 half, and failed saves are pinned beneath rubble.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch
specialQualities: Immunity to electricity, paralysis, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Perpetual sandstorms, buried ruins, desert floating islands
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, ruin court, or storm patrol (Zephyros plus 1-4 blue dragons and desert vassals)
tactics: Creates a sandstorm to blind enemies before attacking from burrowed concealment.
Uses ruin collapse against clustered troops and fortified positions.
Preserves valuable ruins when possible, preferring to trap intruders rather than destroy artifacts.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: blue Dragon Lord of perpetual sandstorms and ancient ruins.

entries.title: Myrilth the Verdant Tyrant
entries.summary: A green Dragon Lord claims a jungle filled with poisonous plants and dangerous wildlife, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Myrilth's power is reinforced by a living domain already hostile to intrusion.
Subjects, hunters, and treasure-seekers must navigate both draconic authority and dense toxic ecology.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as a green-dragon jungle tyrant whose signature is poisonous ecology, beast coercion, and ambush through vegetation.

statBlocks.title: Myrilth the Verdant Tyrant
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +32 melee (3d8+12 plus poison), 2 claws +30 melee (2d8+6), 2 wings +30 melee (2d6+6), and tail slap +30 melee (2d8+18)
specialAttacks: Toxic Canopy Breath (Su): 70-ft. cone, 14d6 acid damage, Reflex DC 28 half, every 1d4 rounds. Failed saves also suffer poison, Fortitude DC 26, 1d4 Constitution/1d4 Constitution.
Predator's Edict (Su): Three times per day, Myrilth may command up to 20 HD of animals or magical beasts within 120 ft. as dominate animal, Will DC 24.
Virulent Bloom (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, poisonous plants erupt in a 30-ft. radius within 100 ft. The area becomes entangled; creatures take 3d6 poison damage each round, Fortitude DC 25 half.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch
specialQualities: Immunity to acid, paralysis, poison, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Poisonous jungle, predatory canopy, toxic wetlands
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, jungle court, or hunting dominion (Myrilth plus 1-4 green dragons and controlled beasts)
tactics: Uses animals and magical beasts as disposable scouts and screens.
Creates Virulent Bloom to immobilize targets before breathing acid and poison.
Avoids exposed combat, repeatedly repositioning through vegetation.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: green Dragon Lord of poisonous jungle and dangerous wildlife.

entries.title: Tharvix the Shadow-Wing
entries.summary: A black Dragon Lord controls acidic swamps, hidden bogs, and decaying ruins, now with converted Hypertext d20-compatible statistics.
body: Tharvix's territory conceals routes, settlements, and old structures beneath murk and corrosive water.
Fear of the ruler compounds the dangers of disease, ambush, and unstable ground.

sections.heading: Conversion posture
body: Built as a black-dragon ambush ruler focused on darkness, corrosive bog terrain, disease, and hidden ruin warfare.

statBlocks.title: Tharvix the Shadow-Wing
statBlocks.fullAttack: Bite +34 melee (3d8+13 plus 2d6 acid), 2 claws +32 melee (2d8+6), 2 wings +32 melee (2d6+6), and tail slap +32 melee (2d8+19)
specialAttacks: Shadow-Acid Breath (Su): 80-ft. line, 15d6 acid damage, Reflex DC 29 half, every 1d4 rounds. The line leaves supernatural darkness for 3 rounds.

Bog-Sink (Su): Once every 1d4 rounds, a 20-ft.-radius area within 100 ft. becomes a sucking bog for 10 rounds. Creatures must succeed on DC 27 Reflex saves or sink, becoming grappled and taking 2d6 acid damage each round.

Ruin Fever (Su): Creatures damaged by Tharvix's bite or claws must succeed on a DC 26 Fortitude save or contract supernatural swamp fever: 1d4 Constitution and 1d4 Wisdom damage after 1 minute; repeat the save daily to recover.
Crush, frightful presence, snatch
specialQualities: Immunity to acid, paralysis, and sleep
statBlocks.environment: Acidic swamps, hidden bogs, decaying ruins
statBlocks.organization: Solitary, shadow court, or bog patrol (Tharvix plus 1-4 black dragons and swamp servants)
tactics: Uses supernatural darkness and underwater routes to remain unseen.
Creates Bog-Sink beneath armored or slow enemies.
Prefers disease, attrition, and repeated ambushes over decisive confrontation.
conversionNotes: Converted from source role: black Dragon Lord of acidic swamps, hidden bogs, and decaying ruins.
